int.title: Integrations
int.hint: Connect a GitHub repository, import issues from Jira or Linear, or link the project's Hosbah app. Imported issues become this project's MG issues and are updated on every sync.
int.disconnectBody: Imported issues stay in Mahaam. For GitHub, uninstall the App on GitHub to revoke its access.
int.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored credential
int.github.desc: Two-way issues, pull requests, commits, workflow runs and deploys through the Mahaam GitHub App.
int.github.noRepos: The installation cannot see any repository yet — grant it one on GitHub.
int.github.connected: GitHub App installed — now pick a repository.
int.jira.desc: Import issues from a Jira Cloud project (every 30 minutes, or on demand).
int.linear.desc: Import issues from a Linear team (every 30 minutes, or on demand).
gh.notLinked: No GitHub repository is linked to this project yet.
gh.pickApp: Choose the app to deploy, then the branch or tag to ship.
gh.noApps: No deployable apps: add a workflow with a workflow_dispatch trigger to the repository.
gh.deployHint: Runs the workflow's workflow_dispatch trigger on the ref you choose.
int.hosbah.desc: Link the project's app on Hosbah: see its status and deployments, deploy, and let the customer open its hosting panel from the portal.
int.hosbah.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for this server's default Hosbah.
int.hosbah.tokenHint: Used only to list your apps and create a token for the one you link. It is not stored.
int.hosbah.noApps: This token can't see any apps.
hosting.notLinked: No Hosbah app is linked to this project
hosting.notLinkedBody: Link the app in the project's settings, under Integrations.
